scripts.stop: sh -c 'lsof -t -i :${1:-8000} | xargs kill -9 || echo "Server not running"' _
scripts.test: conda run -n gen3ai_stable env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest src/ -m 'not slow and not e2e' -q -n 2
scripts.test-all: conda run -n gen3ai_stable env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest src/ -q
scripts.sync-teams: conda run -n gen3ai_stable env PYTHONPATH=src python3 tools/sample_team_downloader/sync.py
